description: The BDH-CMR is the hydrological database of the Matanza-Riachuelo basin authority (ACUMAR), which manages the heavily polluted and flood-prone river basin that crosses southern Buenos Aires. The home page read on 2026-09-28 describes a hydrological information management system to store, organise and give access to information on the basin's water resources: the quality and dynamics of surface water and groundwater, meteorological station data, publications (earlier study reports, scientific papers, ACUMAR reports), water and environmental legislation, images and an interactive map; anyone can use it without registering, as registration is only for the institutions that supply data. The software (version 3.0.0-RC2) was built by the IHLLA hydrology institute between 2003 and 2011. Coverage is the Matanza-Riachuelo basin. Access is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the platform is old, station coverage and record lengths were not read, and data may be updated irregularly. It supports flood and drainage hazard exposure and water quality studies for the Buenos Aires metropolitan area. No related Argentine basin record is catalogued; national hydrological network data complement it.
